battle.name: 俄羅斯入侵中亞
battle.theater: 浩罕汗國費爾干納河谷
battle.brief: 一八六〇年六月，尼古拉·克雷亞諾夫斯基率不足八百人的縱隊越過錫爾河北岸，夜襲托加城，隨後奪烏茲根、安集延，逼浩罕汗國在一八六一年簽約稱臣。卡面這門一八五〇年代的前裝線膛野戰砲是俄軍野戰砲隊骨幹，射程壓過浩罕滑膛老砲，讓小縱隊在數千騎兵環伺之下仍能先以砲火驅散，再以刺刀近戰奪砲。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是俄羅斯帝國與浩罕汗國。俄方並非由單一總督府統一指揮：前線部隊分屬奧倫堡總督府與西西伯利亞總督府兩套體系，包括駐紮錫爾河防線各堡壘的守軍、維爾內與阿拉木圖一帶的要塞守備、從奧倫堡調來的步兵營，以及奧倫堡與錫爾河兩支哥薩克；具體作戰由前線校官率小縱隊自行決斷，後方由兩府供應兵員、彈藥與冬儲，一八六七年才另設錫爾河總督區統一其事。浩罕一方是費爾干納谷地的汗國中央軍隊：哈達亞爾汗以十四五歲之齡即位，兵權握在王族比克與清真寺學者組成的顧問團手中，中央軍以汗國直屬的騎兵、步卒和城防砲隊為骨幹，各城比克自募鄉兵守土，部族兵隨召隨散。汗國內的吉爾吉斯部眾時而受征、時而叛離；布哈拉的可穆塔爾汗與希瓦汗畏懼浩罕坐大費爾干納，各自向俄方靠攏，實質是借俄人之手削浩罕。兩位旁觀者都不是交戰方，卻決定了浩罕的處境。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Russian Empire and the Khanate of Kokand. The Russian side was not run by a single administration: the troops in the field were split between the governorates of Orenburg and of Western Siberia, and consisted of the garrisons of the forts on the Syr Darya line, the garrison of the strongholds around Vernoye and Alma-Ata, infantry battalions transferred up from Orenburg, and the Orenburg and Syr Darya Cossacks. Operational command was exercised on the spot by a field officer leading a small column on his own responsibility, while the two governorates behind him supplied men, ammunition and winter stores; only in 1867 was a separate Syr Darya governorate created to bring all of this under a single head. On the Kokand side stood the central army of a khanate in the Fergana valley. Khudayar Khan had come to the throne at fourteen or fifteen, and the real power lay with the council of royal begs and men of learning attached to the mosques. The core of that army was the khanate's own cavalry, infantry and town artillery, while each city raised local levies for its own walls and tribal contingents came and went with every call-up. The Kyrgyz inside the khanate answered the summons now and then and revolted now and then. Bukhara's Mukhtar Khan and the khan of Khiva, afraid of Kokand growing strong in Fergana, drew closer to the Russians, which in practice meant using the Russians to cut Kokand down. Neither of those two was a belligerent, and yet the state of Kokand was largely settled by them.
people: 浩罕方面: 阿利姆汗於一八六〇年三月被自己的衛兵所殺，幼子哈達亞爾汗繼位，朝廷大權落在攝政貴族與學者顧問手中；王族比克阿卜杜勒·拉希姆早年帶領吉爾吉斯起兵反抗汗國，事後歸順，成為汗國最能打的將領之一，浩罕西北線的防務多出其手；安集延、烏茲根、胡姜各城的比克各自守土，其中安集延一線夾在英商與俄商的商路利益之間，糾葛最深。俄方: 尼古拉·安德烈耶維奇·克雷亞諾夫斯基上校是這次入侵的現場指揮者，率隊夜襲托加、攻取烏茲根與安集延，又在楚潘會戰中指揮俄軍作戰；此外有西伯利亞軍區的邊防軍官、哥薩克頭目與隨縱隊同行的工程兵，後方則是掌握兵源、馬匹與冬儲的軍需官。外圍角色中，布哈拉的可穆塔爾汗與希瓦的馬赫穆德汗各自打算：一面應付浩罕在費爾干納的擴張，一面借俄人的刀。浩罕朝廷內部則有主戰與主和兩派，攝政與軍頭之爭，結局是汗的幼子納西爾丁被送往聖彼得堡，另有一批大臣被清洗。
peopleEn: On the Kokand side, Alim Khan was killed by his own guards in March 1860 and his young son Khudayar Khan inherited the throne, with the real power passing to the regent aristocracy and the scholarly advisers around the court. Abdur Rahim, one of the royal begs, had led the Kyrgyz revolt against the khanate in the middle of the century and had then come back into service; he became one of the ablest commanders the khanate ever had, and much of the defence of the north-western line ran through his hands. The begs of Andijan, Uzgen and Khujand each held their own ground, and the line at Andijan was the one where the commercial claims of English and Russian merchants tangled most deeply. On the Russian side, Colonel Nikolai Andreyevich Krijanovsky was the field commander of the invasion: he led the night attack on Tokmak, the seizure of Uzgen and Andijan, and the Russian army at the battle of Chupan. Around him were the frontier officers of the Siberian military district, the Cossack atamans and the engineers who travelled with the column, and behind them the commissariat officers who controlled the flow of men, horses and winter stores. Among the outside actors, Bukhara's Mukhtar Khan and the khan of Khiva had their own arithmetic: each faced the expansion of Kokand in Fergana, and each preferred to use the Russians to trim it. Inside the Kokand court there were a party for war and a party for negotiation, and the struggle between the regent and the military commanders ended with the khan's young son Nasirdin being taken to St Petersburg and a number of ministers purged.
kits: 卡面這門一八五〇年代的前裝線膛野戰砲，在俄軍序列中的位置是砲兵連一級的野戰砲，與營屬連砲一同編入團的砲兵排。線膛帶來的改變在射程與精度: 同樣藥量之下，炮彈離膛後保持旋轉，飛行更平直、落點更集中，砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏過步兵與騎兵。一八六〇年的俄軍野戰砲隊正是滑膛與線膛混編: 老式滑膛野戰砲仍大量服役，新到的一批六磅至十磅級線膛砲數量有限，卻被集中使用在最需要射程的時刻——一八六〇年六月二十六日夜襲托加，以及同年十二月二十四日楚潘的會戰。浩罕方面正好相反: 中央砲隊的二十八門砲多為滑膛老砲與歐洲商人在喀什買到的舊式前裝砲，火藥與炮彈供應不穩，砲手多為臨時徵召；步兵以火繩與燧發滑膛步槍為主，騎兵用彎刀、長矛與火槍。俄軍步兵同樣是前裝滑膛步槍，哥薩克用卡賓槍與長矛。夜間攻擊靠信號火箭照明加刺刀；渡錫爾河靠浮橋與輕舟；後方補給全靠馬匹與駱駝馱運，砲彈與火藥的重量決定了縱隊能走多遠。
kitsEn: The gun on this card, a muzzle-loading rifled field piece of the 1850s, sat in the Russian order of battle as the field gun of a gun company, drawn into the battery of the regiment alongside the company pieces of the battalion. What rifling changed was reach and accuracy. With the same charge, the spinning projectile left the muzzle on a flatter trajectory and landed more closely, and for the first time the artillery could outrange the infantry and the horsemen. The Russian field artillery in 1860 was a mixture of smoothbores and rifled pieces. The old smoothbore field guns were still in wide service, while the newly arrived rifled guns of the six- and ten-pounder class were few in number but were concentrated for the moments when range mattered most, the night attack on Tokmak on 26 June 1860 and the battle of Chupan on 24 December. The Kokand side was the reverse of this. Most of the twenty-eight guns of the central battery were old smoothbores and pre-existing muzzle-loaders bought by European merchants in Kashgar, with an unsteady supply of powder and shot and crews taken up at the last moment. The Kokand infantry fought with matchlock and flint smoothbore muskets, the cavalry with sabres, long lances and muskets. The Russian infantry used the same pattern of muzzle-loading smoothbore musket, and the Cossacks carried carbines and lances. The night attack depended on signal rockets to light the ground and on the bayonet; the Syr Darya was crossed on pontoons and light boats; and the whole rearward chain was carried by horses and camels, with the weight of powder and shot setting the limit on how far a column could march.
tactics: 俄軍的戰術核心是小縱隊配夜行。縱隊由步兵營、砲兵連、哥薩克與工程兵組成，白天以小隊分散行軍，夜晚宿營於形勢隱蔽處，接近敵營後才集結突擊; 一八六〇年六月二十六日夜襲托加即以此實施: 先以信號火箭照亮浩罕軍的營地與城頭，再以刺刀衝鋒逼退守軍，砲兵同時在近距離內向密集的騎兵射擊，趁亂奪取敵方火砲。楚潘會戰則是另一套: 俄軍以約一千人、十二門砲面對上萬浩罕軍與二十八門砲，砲兵在遠距離上先以線膛砲開火，浩罕密集騎兵在砲火前衝中隊形散亂，砲彈落空的空檔放大成潰散，俄步兵這才以刺刀反擊，隨即追擊奪砲，達到決定性的效果。浩罕的戰術仍屬中亞草原式: 以大量騎兵機動與襲擾，圍攻俄方口岸堡壘企圖拖垮其補給，並以談判爭取時間，等待己方援兵。雙方的約束同樣來自地理: 錫爾河在春季融雪期無法徒步通過，渡河只能靠浮橋; 費爾干納谷地冬季嚴寒、夏季酷熱，馬匹的飼料與水源決定行軍距離，縱隊因此不能久留一地，必須連續推進。
tacticsEn: The core of the Russian method was a small column moving by night. Each column combined an infantry battalion, a gun company, Cossacks and sappers; by day the men marched dispersed in small groups and by night they bivouacked in ground that concealed them, massing only after they had closed on the enemy. That is how the attack on Tokmak on 26 June 1860 was made. Signal rockets first lit up the Kokand camp and the walls of the town, the infantry went in with the bayonet to drive the defenders out, the guns fired at close range into the massed cavalry, and the disorder of the moment was used to seize the enemy's artillery. Chupan was a different pattern. The Russians brought about a thousand men and twelve guns against some ten thousand Kokandis and twenty-eight guns. The artillery opened at long range with the rifled pieces, the dense cavalry of the khanate broke up as it charged, the gaps left by the shells opened into a rout, and only then did the Russian infantry counterattack with the bayonet and go on to take the guns, which decided the action. The tactics of Kokand remained those of the Central Asian steppe: massed cavalry manoeuvre and harassment, siege of the Russian river forts in an attempt to starve them of supply, and negotiation bought with time while reinforcements were gathered. Geography constrained both sides equally. The Syr Darya could not be forded on foot during the spring flood and could only be bridged with pontoons; the Fergana valley was bitterly cold in winter and burning in summer; and the availability of forage and water for the horses set the distance a column could march, so that no column could stay long in one place and had to keep pushing on.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。夜襲托加在一八六〇年六月二十六日（俄曆六月十八日），俄軍縱隊約六百至八百人，配四至六門野戰砲；浩罕方面在托加及周邊的兵力以數千計，其中多為騎兵。交火後托加城與汗國的營地淪陷，俄軍取去數門砲與大批軍需。烏茲根在同年八月下旬失守，安集延於八月至九月間被俄軍佔領。楚潘會戰在一八六〇年十二月二十四日，俄軍出動約八百至一千人、十二門砲，浩罕軍則有約一萬人、二十八門砲；俄方戰史常引的浩罕兵力估計在八千至一萬二千之間，而浩罕全軍二十八門砲幾乎全數淪陷。行軍距離方面，縱隊自錫爾河口岸南下至托加，路程約三百至四百公里，每日行進約一百俄里，即一百零七公里上下。傷亡方面，俄軍在數十人量級，浩罕軍的損失以數百計，各方記載互有出入。割地與條款方面：浩罕割出安集延、烏茲根與錫爾河北岸，並支付一筆賠款（數目在各方記載中不一），接受俄方在浩罕城的駐節與駐軍；哈達亞爾汗保留汗號但受俄方監督，汗的幼子納西爾丁被送往聖彼得堡。戰役自一八六〇年春俄軍越境起，至一八六一年一月十一日條約簽訂為止。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked run roughly as follows. The attack on Tokmak took place on 26 June 1860 (18 June Old Style). The Russian column was about six to eight hundred men with four to six field guns, while the Kokand force at and around Tokmak ran to several thousand, most of it cavalry. After the action the town and the khanate's camp were lost, and the Russians took several of the guns together with a large quantity of stores. Uzgen had fallen by late August of the same year, and Andijan was occupied by the Russians between August and September. The battle of Chupan was fought on 24 December 1860. The Russians took the field with about eight hundred to a thousand men and twelve guns against a Kokand army of roughly ten thousand men and twenty-eight guns; the estimate of the Kokand strength commonly quoted in the Russian accounts runs from eight thousand to twelve thousand, and almost the whole of the twenty-eight gun battery was lost. On distance, the column marched from the river forts south to Tokmak over a route of some three hundred to four hundred kilometres, covering about one hundred versts, that is roughly one hundred and seven kilometres, in a day. On casualties, the Russians lost a few dozen men and the Kokandis lost a number in the hundreds, with the accounts differing from one another. On the terms, Kokand ceded Andijan, Uzgen and the north bank of the Syr Darya and paid an indemnity, the amount of which differs from account to account, and accepted a Russian resident and Russian troops at the city of Kokand; Khudayar Khan kept the title of khan but under Russian supervision, and the khan's young son Nasirdin was sent to St Petersburg. The campaign ran from the Russian crossing into the khanate in the spring of 1860 to the signature of the treaty on 11 January 1861.
cause: 動因有四層。第一是邊界：浩罕汗國控制著錫爾河上游與楚河、阿拉套盆地，向北伸入吉爾吉斯人的牧地，與俄羅斯在維爾內、阿拉木圖一帶的要塞線正面相接，雙方都明白這條河線再往南推就是費爾干納。第二是商路與商品：安集延與浩罕城是生絲與棉花的集散地，喀什與中亞的商隊都從這裡走；一八五〇年代俄商南下屢屢受阻，稅關與護商權之爭，使俄方需要一個能直接管到費爾干納的據點。第三是借口：一八五八年春，浩罕軍民在巴扎庫爾貢堡殺害了俄軍守備，這起事件被俄方長期引用，成為出兵的理由；此前浩罕王公在吉爾吉斯起義中曾依賴俄軍鎮壓，關係由合作轉為猜忌。第四是力弱：一八六〇年三月阿利姆汗被殺，幼君哈達亞爾汗的朝廷在攝政與軍頭之間分裂，浩罕中央軍雖人數眾多卻指揮不統一；布哈拉與希瓦又主動拉攏俄方，聯手削弱浩罕。
causeEn: There were four layers to the cause. The first was the frontier. The Khanate of Kokand held the upper Syr Darya and the basins of the Chu and the Alatau, reaching north into Kyrgyz pasture, and it stood directly against the Russian line of forts around Vernoye and Alma-Ata; both sides understood that pushing that line further south meant Fergana. The second was trade and commodities. Andijan and the city of Kokand were the collecting points for raw silk and cotton, and the caravans out of Kashgar and across Central Asia all passed through them; Russian merchants moving south in the 1850s were obstructed at every stage, and disputes over customs and the escort of traders gave Moscow a reason to want direct control of Fergana. The third was the pretext. In the spring of 1858 the garrison of the Russian fort of Bazar-Korgon was killed by Kokand troops and townsmen, and the incident was quoted by the Russians for years afterwards as a justification for the campaign; before that, the Kokand princes had relied on Russian troops to put down the Kyrgyz revolt, and the relationship had turned from cooperation to suspicion. The fourth was weakness on the other side. After Alim Khan was killed in March 1860, the court of the boy khan Khudayar split between regents and military commanders, and although the central army was numerous its command was not unified; Bukhara and Khiva in turn courted the Russians, and both of them wanted Kokand diminished.
impact: 這場戰爭把浩罕從獨立的汗國變成俄羅斯的附庸，是中亞被逐步吞併的起點。安集延與烏茲根落入俄方之手後，費爾干納谷地的棉產、生絲與商隊通道盡在俄方掌握，一八六五年俄軍入據塔什干、一八六八年攻下撒馬爾罕、一八七三年平定希瓦，都沿著這條由費爾干納打開的通道推進；一八七五年浩罕民眾起義請求俄羅斯保護，一八七六年汗國被正式廢除。軍事技術上的後果更直接：線膛前裝野戰砲在射程上壓過滑膛砲，使上萬騎兵配二十八門滑膛老砲的典型中亞軍隊在砲火中崩潰，砲兵加刺刀的合成打法自此被證明足以對付純騎兵隊，砲兵加長矛的舊秩序在中亞走到盡頭，而這套打法在一八七六年的阿賴戰役中再次被搬上舞台。俄羅斯在錫爾河兩岸建立起新的要塞與居民點，一八六七年設錫爾河總督區，把中亞的行政與軍政分界重新劃定，費爾干納的居民此後開始學會在商隊護衛、傳教士與俄式郵政之間周旋。
impactEn: This war turned an independent khanate into a Russian vassal and was the opening move in the piecemeal conquest of Central Asia. With Andijan and Uzgen in Russian hands, the cotton, the raw silk and the caravan roads of the Fergana valley followed; the Russian entry into Tashkent in 1865, the taking of Samarkand in 1868 and the campaign against Khiva in 1873 all advanced along the corridor opened through Fergana; and in 1875 the people of Kokand rose and asked for Russian protection, after which the khanate was formally abolished in 1876. The technical consequence was even more direct. The rifled muzzle-loading field gun outranged the smoothbore, and a typical Central Asian army of ten thousand horsemen with twenty-eight smoothbore guns broke up under its fire. A combination of artillery and the bayonet was thereby shown to be sufficient against a purely mounted force, and the old order of guns and lances in Central Asia ran out of road; that method was carried onto the stage again at the Alai in 1876. On the Russian side, new forts and settlements rose on both banks of the Syr Darya, and in 1867 a Syr Darya governorate was created, redrawing the administrative and military limits of Central Asia. The people of Fergana from then on had to move between caravan escorts, missionaries and the Russian postal system.
result: 楚潘一役之後，浩罕求和。一八六一年一月十一日簽訂的條約規定：浩罕割出安集延、烏茲根與錫爾河北岸，支付一筆賠款，接受俄方在浩罕城的駐節與駐軍；哈達亞爾汗保留汗位，名義上仍統治汗國，實則受俄方監督，中央軍被解散，砲隊與火藥交出，汗的幼子納西爾丁被送往聖彼得堡。軍事上是一場完勝：托加夜襲摧毀了浩罕的野戰砲隊與前進基地，楚潘一戰盡奪二十八門砲，汗國最後能獨立的野戰力量不再存在，費爾干納各城失去屏障，陸續歸附。從結果看，浩罕的國家形式保存到一八七六年，但實質主權已經出讓。俄羅斯用半年時間、不足兩千人的部隊，結束了一個汗國的獨立地位，也為之後征服布哈拉與希瓦定下了同一套辦法：小縱隊、線膛砲、夜襲，以及在對方主城之前及時停手。
resultEn: After Chupan, Kokand asked for terms. The treaty of 11 January 1861 provided that Kokand should cede Andijan, Uzgen and the north bank of the Syr Darya, pay an indemnity, and accept a Russian resident and Russian troops at the city of Kokand. Khudayar Khan kept the title of khan and still ruled the khanate in name, but under Russian supervision; the central army was disbanded, the guns and the powder were handed over, and the khan's young son Nasirdin was sent to St Petersburg. Militarily it was a complete win. The night attack on Tokmak destroyed the Kokand field battery and its forward base; the battle of Chupan took all twenty-eight guns; and the last field force the khanate could raise independently ceased to exist, the towns of Fergana losing their shield and coming over one after another. In result, the form of the khanate survived until 1876, but the substance of its sovereignty had already been given away. Russia had ended the independence of a khanate with half a year of work and fewer than two thousand men, and had settled on the method that would be used against Bukhara and Khiva: a small column, rifled guns, a night attack, and a timely halt in front of the enemy's own capital.
